sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding bundle the fastener kit with one distributor.
Our latest forecast for part:360010 grows +6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
Our latest forecast for part:360011 grows +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).
Our latest forecast for part:360012 grows +9.0% (fc:360012@2026-09).
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 30,000 complete bundles of part:360010, part:360011, part:360012, part:360030 per year over 36 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.59 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
Here is the background.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have already taken that volume change data into account.
We welcome the positive volume forecasts and your commitment to a 36-month contract.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, our team will address this topic separately.
To support this long-term partnership with 60-day payment terms, we can reduce our price to €5.56 per unit.
Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer and the updated forecast for the final component of the bundle. Since we have already factored the anticipated volume growth into our previous calculation, we kindly ask you to share the underlying data for these forecasts.

We are pleased to present our offer at a price of €5.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

To acknowledge your movement, we are prepared to reduce our price to €5.49 per unit for a 36-month contract with 60-day payment terms, alongside our alternative proposal at a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
